question: Mr. Alfred buys two lots mangoes. the first lot costs him TK.300 per dozen and the second TK. 500 per dozen. He sold all the mangoes at TK. 400 per dozen. Find his profit/loss percentage if he spent the same amount of money on each of the lots.
explanation:
🔖ধরি, প্রতি লটে x টাকা খরচ হচ্ছে Total cost = 2x
১ম Lot এ number of dozen = \( \frac{x}{300} \) ; দ্বিতীয়তে = \( \frac{x}{500} \)
Total dozen = \( \frac{x}{300}+\frac{x}{500}=\frac{2}{315}x \)
তাহলে total selling price = \( \frac{2}{375}x\times 400=\frac{32}{15}x \)
তাহলে profit = \( \frac{32}{15}x-x=\frac{2}{15}x \) [যদি selling-cost = negative তবে loss হতো]
তাহলে 2x টাকায় লাভ হয় \( \frac{2}{15}x \)
⸫ 1x " " " \( \frac{2x}{15\times 2x} \)
" 100 " " " \( \frac{2x\times 100}{15\times 2x} \)
= \( \frac{20}{3}=6\frac{2}{3} \)
অর্থাৎ \( 6\frac{2}{3}\% \)
subject: গাণিতিক যুক্তি
exam: 13@United Commercial Bank Ltd - Management Trainee Officer - 07.06.13

question: The ratio of the sum of the reciprocals of x and y to the product of the reciprocals of x and y is 1:3. What is sum of the numbers x and y?
explanation:
🔖\( \frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y}:\frac{1}{x}\times \frac{1}{y}=1:3 \)
⇒ \( \frac{{\displaystyle \frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{y}}}{{\displaystyle \frac{1}{xy}}}=\frac{1}{3} \)
⇒ \( \frac{x+y}{xy}\times xy=\frac{1}{3} \)
⸫ \( x+y=\frac{1}{3} \)
subject: গাণিতিক যুক্তি
